newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PEPGRO DETAILS CAP AWARD.
newsitem.headline: PEPGRO DETAILS CAP AWARD.

text.p: Pepgro Ltd said on Monday a capitalisation share award would be made to ordinary shareholders on register on September 13.

The number of new ordinary shares shareholders would be entitled to receive would be calculated by multiplying the number of ordinary shares held at the record date by the 16.5 cents proposed cash dividend, which would be divided by the "issue price".
The "issue price" is the weighted average of the trading price of the ordinary shares on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange for the three days ending October 10 discounted by a factor of 10 percent.
Shareholders may elect to receive instead a cash dividend of 16.5 cents instead.
